headline_findings.rank_sweep_is_nonmonotonic: finetuned dPPL%: r4=+2.21, r8=+1.45 (best), r16=+2.04, r32=+2.58 -- more params does NOT monotonically help within this fixed 387-step training budget; r8 is a sweet spot, likely because r16/r32 overfit the small finetune slice faster (same pattern as Track C's bridge overfitting after epoch 1)
headline_findings.none_beat_track_B: Track B (o_proj replacement, 6152 params) fine-tuned dPPL%=+1.09% remains the best result anywhere in this investigation; F2's best (r8, +1.45%) does not surpass it at any rank tried
headline_findings.L24_pattern_breaks_from_track_A: Track A's per-bin SpectralFilter got ZERO benefit from training at L24 (noop +16.03% vs trained +16.25%, statistically indistinguishable). F2 at L24 DOES get real benefit from training (noop +16.05% vs trained +12.46%, a genuine improvement) -- F2's better architecture breaks that specific failure mode, though L24 remains by far the worst insertion point in absolute terms for both architectures.
